raw_text:
Below is a 12-week, three-phase strength program designed for a 36-year-old recreational lifter returning from a right medial meniscus tear. Surgeon has cleared low-impact strength work, with no jumping and no deep knee flexion under load. The plan emphasizes controlled ranges, gradual loading, knee-friendly patterns, and progressive return to strength and skiing-specific demands without plyometrics. It includes week-by-week structure, sessions, sets/reps, and guidance on modifications, tempo, and recovery.

Key guardrails and cues
- No jumping or running.
- Avoid deep knee flexion under load: keep squat/knee-dominant work in a 0–60° knee flexion zone early, then cautiously up to ~70–80° by Phase 3 if symptom-free.
- Prioritize unilateral symmetry, controlled eccentrics, and isometric options.
- Pain rule: 0–2/10 acceptable during/after; symptoms must settle within 24 hours and not worsen week to week. If pain >3/10, reduce ROM, load, or volume.
- Tempo: use controlled eccentrics (3–4 seconds) for quad work; avoid end-range knee compression.

Structure overview
- Frequency: 3 strength days/week (A, B, C), 1–2 low-impact conditioning days/week, daily short mobility/prehab.
- Progression: double progression (reps then load), or 2.5–5% load increases when top reps achieved with good form and no knee irritation.
- Primary emphases by phase:
  - Phase 1 (Weeks 1–4): Restore base strength, tolerance to loaded patterns in safe ROM, isometrics, hip/hamstring/glute dominance, trunk stiffness, balance.
  - Phase 2 (Weeks 5–8): Build bilateral strength, increase unilateral loading, controlled ROM expansion as tolerated, introduce anti-rotation and hinge loads.
  - Phase 3 (Weeks 9–12): Strength-power bridge without impact: heavy slow resistance, overcoming/ yielding isometrics, ski-specific endurance, deceleration control drills (non-impact).

Warm-up template (10–12 min, all strength days)
- Soft tissue: 2–3 min quads, adductors, glutes, calves.
- Mobility (gentle, pain-free):
  - Ankle rocks (knee to wall) 2x10/side
  - Hip flexor rocker 2x8/side
  - 90/90 hip rotations 2x6/side
- Activation:
  - Terminal knee extension band (TKE) 2x15/side (pause 2s)
  - Mini-band lateral walks 2x12 steps/side
  - Glute bridge iso 2x20–30s
- Movement prep:
  - Bodyweight box squat to high box 2x8 (pain-free depth)
  - Split-stance RDL dowel 2x6/side

Weekly recovery and conditioning
- Conditioning (choose 1–2 days/wk): bike, elliptical, rowing (monitor knee). 20–35 min Z2; add 4–6x30–45s Z3 efforts as tolerated by Week 4+. No hills with high knee flexion on bike initially (raise saddle).
- Daily: 5–8 min of TKEs, calf/quad light mobility, patellar tendon soft tissue, and 5 min easy spin/walk on off days.
- Sleep: 7–9 hours; protein target 1.6–2.2 g/kg/day; creatine monohydrate 3–5 g/day if no contraindications; omega-3 1–2 g EPA/DHA; maintain slight caloric surplus for strength (100–300 kcal/day) unless weight management goals differ.
- Swelling monitoring: if swelling increases after a session, reduce next session’s knee ROM and volume, add extra isometrics, and ice/elevation post-session.

Exercise key/ROM notes
- Box height for squats set so knee flexion stays within target angle. Gradually lower box only if completely symptom-free for 2 weeks at current depth.
- Tempo notation: e.g., 3-1-1 = 3s down, 1s pause, 1s up.
- Unilateral work: begin affected side first; match volume to weaker side, not stronger.

PHASE 1: Rebuild and Tolerance (Weeks 1–4)
Goal: Reinforce knee-safe patterns, start strength in limited ROM, emphasize hip hinge, glute, hamstring strength, and isometrics for quads. Improve balance and trunk stiffness.

Weekly schedule suggestion:
- Mon: Day A (Lower-dominant, knee-safe)
- Wed: Day B (Upper + core)
- Fri: Day C (Lower/hinge + unilateral)
- 1–2 conditioning days Tue/Sat

Week 1
Day A
- Box Squat (high box, 0–50° knee flexion), 3-1-1 tempo: 4x6, RPE 6–7
- Spanish Squat Isometric (band behind knees), mid-range: 4x20–30s
- Trap Bar Deadlift (high handles), 2-1-1: 4x5, RPE 6–7
- Reverse Sled Drag (light–moderate), 6x20–25 m, steady
- Standing Calf Raise: 3x10–12
- Core: Side Plank: 3x25–35s/side

Day B
- Bench Press: 5x5, RPE 7
- Chest-supported Row: 4x8
- Half-kneeling Cable Press (anti-extension focus): 3x10/side
- Lat Pulldown (neutral grip): 3x8–10
- Pallof Press ISO: 3x20–30s/side
- Shoulder external rotation (cable/band): 3x12–15

Day C
- Romanian Deadlift: 4x6, RPE 7
- Split-Stance RDL (DB): 3x8/side
- Step-Up to High Box (limit knee flexion to ~60°, control): 3x6/side, 3-1-1
- Seated Leg Curl: 3x10–12, 2-1-1
- TKE (band): 3x15–20/side, 2s squeeze
- Farmer Carry: 4x25–30 m

Week 2
- Aim +2.5–5% load on primary lifts if pain-free; keep ROM same.
Day A
- Box Squat: 4x6–7
- Spanish Squat ISO: 4x25–35s
- Trap Bar DL (high handle): 5x4, RPE 7
- Reverse Sled Drag: 6x25–30 m
- Seated Calf Raise: 3x12–15
- Copenhagen Plank (short lever): 3x15–20s/side

Day B
- Incline DB Press: 4x8
- One-arm Cable Row: 4x8–10/side
- Landmine Press (half-kneel): 3x8/side
- Face Pull: 3x12–15
- Dead Bug with banded TKE: 3x8/side
- Wrist/forearm prehab: 2x15

Day C
- RDL: 4x6–7
- Step-Up (same depth): 4x6/side
- Seated Leg Curl: 4x10
- Hamstring Slide-outs (heels on towels/slider): 3x6–8 (pain-free)
- TKE: 3x15–20
- Suitcase Carry: 4x25 m/side

Week 3
- If symptom-free, small ROM increase on squats/step-ups (5–10°) OR small load increase, not both.
Day A
- Box Squat (slightly lower if tolerated): 5x5, RPE 7–8
- Spanish Squat ISO: 5x20–30s
- Trap Bar DL (high): 4x5, RPE 7–8
- Reverse Sled Drag (moderate): 6x25–30 m
- Calf Raise (single-leg, supported): 3x10/side
- Side Plank Reach-through: 3x8/side

Day B
- Bench Press: 5x3–4, RPE 7–8
- Chest-supported Row: 4x6–8
- Cable Fly (low incline): 3x10–12
- Neutral-grip Pull-up/Assisted: 3x5–8
- Pallof Press ISO: 3x25–35s/side
- Scap Y/T/W: 2x10

Day C
- RDL: 5x5
- Deficit RDL (very small, 1–2"): 3x6 (if hamstrings tolerate; avoids knee flexion)
- Step-Up: 3x6–8/side
- Seated Leg Curl: 3x10–12
- TKE: 3x20
- Farmer Carry: 4x30 m

Week 4 (deload volume, maintain quality; keep ROM same or slightly reduced if any irritability)
Day A
- Box Squat: 3x5, RPE 6–7
- Spanish Squat ISO: 3x20–30s
- Trap Bar DL: 3x4, RPE 6–7
- Reverse Sled Drag: 4x20–25 m
- Calf Raise: 2x12
- Side Plank: 2x30s

Day B
- Bench Press: 3x4, RPE 6–7
- Row: 3x8
- Landmine Press: 2x8/side
- Face Pull: 2x12
- Pallof ISO: 2x25s/side

Day C
- RDL: 3x5
- Step-Up: 2x6/side
- Seated Leg Curl: 2x10
- TKE: 2x15
- Carry: 3x25 m

PHASE 2: Build Strength and Controlled ROM (Weeks 5–8)
Goal: Progress bilateral strength, cautiously deepen knee ROM if symptom-free, increase unilateral work, add anti-rotation, introduce controlled eccentrics and tempo variations. No plyometrics.

Weekly schedule: same as Phase 1.

ROM guideline this phase
- If Weeks 1–4 symptom-free, work toward 60–70° knee flexion under load on squats/step-ups by Week 7–8. If any symptoms, hold at previous tolerable depth.

Week 5
Day A
- Safety Bar Box Squat (moderate box height), 3-1-1: 5x4, RPE 7–8
- Spanish Squat ISO or Heel-Elevated Wall Sit ISO (mid-range): 4x30–40s
- Trap Bar Deadlift (mix high/low handle if form pristine; start with high): 5x3–4, RPE 8
- Reverse Sled Drag (heavier): 6x20–25 m
- Tibialis Raise (seated/against wall): 3x15
- Copenhagen Plank (medium lever): 3x20–25s/side

Day B
- Overhead Press: 5x3–5
- One-arm Chest-supported Row: 4x8/side
- Push-up on handles: 3x8–12
- Lat Pulldown or Assisted Pull-up: 4x6–8
- Anti-rotation Cable Press (split-stance): 3x10/side
- Prone Cobra: 2x30–40s

Day C
- Romanian Deadlift: 5x4–5, RPE 8
- Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat to shallow depth (limit to 50–60° knee flexion; short stride to bias quads less): 3x6/side, 3-1-1; or split squat with front foot elevated if RFESS irritates knee
- Seated Leg Curl (heavier): 4x8–10
- Step-Up (same or slightly higher box): 3x6–8/side
- TKE: 3x20
- Suitcase Carry: 4x30 m/side

Week 6
- Progress 2.5–5% loads if symptom-free.
Day A
- SSB Box Squat: 5x3–4, RPE 8
- Heel-Elevated Wall Sit ISO: 4x35–45s
- Trap Bar DL: 6x3 (low–moderate handle as tolerated), RPE 8
- Reverse Sled Drag: 6x25–30 m
- Standing Calf Raise: 3x10–12
- Side Plank with abduction: 3x20s/side

Day B
- Bench Press: 5x3–5
- Chest-supported Row: 4x6–8
- Landmine Press: 3x6–8/side
- Neutral-grip Pull-up/Assisted: 4x4–6
- Pallof Press ISO: 3x30–35s/side
- Scap Y/T/W: 2x10–12

Day C
- RDL: 4x5
- Split Squat variation (as above): 3x6–8/side
- Hamstring Slide-outs: 3x8–10
- Step-Up: 3x6–8/side
- TKE: 3x20–25
- Farmer Carry: 4x30–40 m

Week 7
- Optionally lower squat box slightly if all green; maintain tempo.
Day A
- SSB Box Squat (slightly deeper if tolerated): 5x3, RPE 8–8.5
- Spanish Squat ISO: 4x30–40s
- Trap Bar DL: 5x3, RPE 8–8.5
- Reverse Sled Drag (heavy): 6x20 m
- Tibialis Raise: 3x15–20
- Copenhagen (longer lever): 3x20–25s

Day B
- Overhead Press: 6x2–3, RPE 8
- One-arm Row: 4x6–8/side
- DB Incline Press: 3x6–8
- Lat Pulldown: 3x6–8
- Anti-rotation Press Walkout: 3x4–5 steps/side
- Dead Bug: 3x8/side

Day C
- RDL: 5x4, RPE 8–8.5
- Front-Foot-Elevated Split Squat (shallow): 3x6–8/side
- Seated Leg Curl (heavy): 4x6–8
- Step-Down (small step, control, 3-2-1 tempo, non-impact): 3x5/side, pain-free depth
- TKE: 3x20–25
- Suitcase Carry: 4x35 m/side

Week 8 (volume taper, intensity maintained)
Day A
- SSB Box Squat: 4x3, RPE 8
- Wall Sit ISO: 3x30–40s
- Trap Bar DL: 4x3, RPE 8
- Reverse Sled Drag: 4x20–25 m
- Calf Raise: 2x12–15
- Side Plank: 2x30–40s

Day B
- Bench Press: 4x3, RPE 8
- Row: 3x6–8
- Landmine Press: 2x6–8/side
- Pull-up/Assisted: 3x4–6
- Pallof ISO: 2x30s/side

Day C
- RDL: 3x4–5
- Split Squat: 2–3x6/side
- Seated Leg Curl: 3x8
- Step-Down: 2x5/side
- TKE: 2x20
- Farmer Carry: 3x35 m

PHASE 3: Strength–Power Bridge and Ski-Specific Prep (Weeks 9–12)
Goal: Increase maximal strength within safe ROM, add quasi-isometrics/overcoming isometrics, deceleration and isometric endurance relevant to skiing, and metabolic leg endurance without impact. Continue to avoid deep knee flexion under load; operate within individually tolerated 60–80° max. Focus on strong positions, trunk stiffness, and lateral hip strength.

Weekly schedule: same. Conditioning now includes 1 day of longer Z2 (30–40 min) and 1 day of interval work (bike/elliptical): 6–8x60s Z4 with 90s easy, or 8–12x20s high cadence/torque efforts with 100s easy. Stop if knee pain rises.

Week 9
Day A
- Hatfield Box Squat (SSB with hand support), controlled depth: 5x3, RPE 8–8.5
- Overcoming Isometric Squat vs. pins (mid-range angle): 5x5–6s efforts (build tension to max over 2s)
- Trap Bar Deadlift (low handles if symmetrical and pain-free): 5x2–3, RPE 8.5
- Reverse Sled Drag (heavy): 6x20 m
- Lateral Band Walks: 3x12–15 steps/side
- Copenhagen Plank (long lever): 3x25–30s

Day B
- Push Press (strict if knee discomfort with dip): 5x2–3 at RPE 7–8 (short dip, no bounce)
- Weighted Pull-up/Assisted: 5x3–5
- Single-arm DB Bench: 3x6–8/side
- Chest-supported Row: 3x6–8
- Anti-rotation Press Walkout: 3x5 steps/side
- Stir-the-pot (Swiss ball): 2x20 circles each way

Day C
- Barbell RDL: 5x3–4, RPE 8.5
- Lateral Step-Down (small step, 3-2-1 tempo): 3x5–6/side
- Seated Leg Curl (heavy): 4x6
- Spanish Squat ISO (burner set): 3x30–40s
- TKE: 3x20–25
- Suitcase Carry: 4x40 m/side

Week 10
Day A
- Hatfield Box Squat: 6x2–3, RPE 8.5
- Yielding ISO Squat hold at working depth: 3x20–30s
- Trap Bar DL: 6x2, RPE 8.5–9
- Reverse Sled Drag (very heavy, short): 8x15–20 m
- Standing Calf Raise: 3x10–12
- Side Plank with row (cable): 3x8/side

Day B
- Bench Press: 5x2–3, RPE 8–8.5
- One-arm Row: 4x6/side
- Landmine Press: 3x5–6/side
- Pull-up/Assisted: 4x3–5
- Pallof ISO: 3x30–35s/side

Day C
- Barbell RDL: 5x3, RPE 8.5–9
- Front-Foot-Elevated Split Squat (shallow): 3x5–6/side, 3-1-1
- Seated Leg Curl: 4x6–8
- Step-Up (controlled): 3x5–6/side
- TKE: 3x20–25
- Farmer Carry: 4x40–50 m

Week 11
- Peak strength within safe ROM; keep knee calm.
Day A
- Hatfield Box Squat: 5x2 at RPE 9 (spotter/safeties)
- Overcoming ISO vs. pins: 4x5–6s max
- Trap Bar DL: 5x2 at RPE 9
- Reverse Sled Drag: 6x20 m
- Tibialis Raise: 3x15–20
- Copenhagen (long lever): 3x25–30s

Day B
- Push Press or Strict Press: 5x2–3, RPE 8–8.5
- Weighted Pull-up/Assisted: 4x3–4
- DB Incline Press: 3x5–6
- Chest-supported Row: 3x6
- Anti-rotation Walkout: 3x5 steps/side
- Dead Bug: 3x8/side

Day C
- Barbell RDL: 4x3, RPE 8.5
- Lateral Step-Down: 3x6/side
- Seated Leg Curl: 3x6–8
- Spanish Squat ISO: 3x30–40s
- TKE: 3x20–25
- Suitcase Carry: 4x40 m/side

Week 12 (taper and testing readiness; no max testing under deep knee flexion)
Day A
- Hatfield Box Squat: 3x2 at RPE 8
- Yielding ISO hold at depth: 2x20s
- Trap Bar DL: 3x2 at RPE 8
- Reverse Sled Drag: 4x20 m
- Calf Raise: 2x10–12
- Side Plank: 2x30s

Day B
- Bench Press: 3x3 at RPE 7–8
- Row: 3x6–8
- Landmine Press: 2x6/side
- Pull-up/Assisted: 2x4–6
- Pallof ISO: 2x25s/side

Day C
- Barbell RDL: 3x3 at RPE 8
- Step-Up: 2x6/side
- Seated Leg Curl: 2x8
- TKE: 2x20
- Farmer Carry: 3x40 m

Ski-specific adjunct work (Weeks 6–12, 2–3x/week, add after main lift or separate short sessions)
- Isometric wall sits with torso upright, feet slightly forward to keep knee angle mid-range: build to 3x40–60s.
- Lateral band slides and monster walks: 2–3x12–15 steps.
- Hip airplane (supported): 2x5/side.
- Slider lateral lunges to shallow depth (no bounce; 2-2-1 tempo): 2–3x6/side as tolerated from Week 7 onward.
- Core anti-rotation and anti-lateral flexion (Pallof variations, suitcase carries): already included; keep progressing.
- Balance/proprioception: single-leg stance on Airex pad 2x30–45s/side; progress eyes closed only if rock-solid and pain-free.

Progression and load management
- Use RPE and pain/symptom response to adjust. If knee discomfort >2/10 or swelling next day:
  - Reduce ROM (raise box/step), decrease eccentric tempo stress, cut volume by ~30% next session.
  - Swap split squats for more isometrics and sled drags that session.
- When consistently hitting top reps cleanly across sets without symptoms, increase load 2.5–5% next week.

Return-to-ski readiness indicators (not formal clearance)
- Symmetrical step-ups and step-downs with controlled tempo and no pain.
- Reverse sled drag bodyweight x 20–30 m for 6–8 sets without knee irritation.
- Hatfield box squat with bodyweight on bar x 2–3 reps at training depth, pain-free.
- 40–60s wall sit x 3 sets, even quad fatigue, no joint pain.
- Y-balance/lunge reach within 4 cm symmetry side-to-side.

Notes and substitutions
- If any squat pattern remains irritable, use leg press with limited ROM and feet higher/wider to control knee angles.
- Cycling: keep saddle high early; avoid low cadence/high torque at deep angles. Progress to moderate torque intervals in Phase 3 if knee remains calm.
- If RFESS provokes medial knee, pivot to front-foot-elevated split squat or supported split squat (hands on rack).

This plan provides a clear, progressive path to rebuild strength and control within safe knee ranges while preparing tissues and movement qualities relevant to skiing, without violating the no-jump and no-deep-flexion constraints.
